entries.headline: James Wood stayed in the yard
entries.story: James Wood went 1-for-4 against River Ryan and the Detroit Tigers. No real scare on the HR front, striking out 3 times.

entries.headline: Pete Alonso connected at +357
entries.story: Pete Alonso cashed. Facing Trey Yesavage, he went deep in the 1st in his 1st at bat. The call: "Pete Alonso homers (39) on a fly ball to right field." He added another later in the game. Final line: 2-for-4.
